0022600086.text: Both the Milwaukee Bucks and Washington Wizards open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with the Bucks visiting Washington. The Wizards are without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), all listed as out. Milwaukee lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 109-99 defeat in Washington on January 29, 2026.
